objective: Build EXPLAIN qualified column names directly into a preallocated String instead of collecting parts into a temporary Vec.

tasks.title: Preallocate EXPLAIN qualified column names
tasks.result: EXPLAIN now builds compound identifier column names into a preallocated String and has direct qualified primary-key lookup coverage.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves compound identifier segment order, dot separators, and resolve_column_index behavior.
